Resolves #20489

`Xhr#request` now adds its params through `appendParams(url, params)` instead of an unconditional `'?' + params`. The params join an existing query with `&` and go before a `#fragment`. An empty query (`/data?`) or one ending in `&` gets no second separator, while a `?` inside a query value stays part of it. Empty params leave the URL as it is. String composition keeps relative URLs relative. The keyless Earthquakes tutorial's Store URL (`…/go/?fn=earthquakes`) now goes out as `…/go/?fn=earthquakes&page=1&pageSize=0`. This unblocks #6611.

Micro-review eligible: contained bug fix — one method, one call site, one spec.

Evidence: L2 in CI (unit spec through `Xhr#request` with a recording `XMLHttpRequest`) + L3 outside CI (Sophie's packed-consumer run of this exact head, below) → L2 required (every AC is a composed URL). Residual: none. #6611's tutorial acceptance stays with Sophie.
